TEXT:
[FI] After touring the Studio Park, we didn't have 
anywhere else we wanted to go.
[FI] Eventually, we decided to visit the Gion Machiya.

[FI] ...In the meantime, my point card's filling up with 
stamps.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Nmph... All this walking sure gets tiring. Don't you 
agree, Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah... Where should we go next?

[FI] We had tea and anmitsu at a rest stand nearby 
while we discussed our next destination.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Hmm, it's getting dark now, so we probably 
shouldn't go anywhere too far.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I think we've gone pretty far already.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, you're right. I mean, we're on a vacation, 
after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well, I feel like we can just take it easy. Is there 
anywhere you'd like to visit, Manami?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm satisfied at this point. I would like to stop over 
some souvenir shops, though.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I'd like to pick something up myself too. Let's finish 
this up before going.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Okay.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, just a moment.

[FI] I noticed some brown sugar syrup on the corner of 
Manami's mouth.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hold still.

[FI] I take out my handkerchief and wipe the syrup 
away.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Nn... Thanks, Kyou-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Okay, let me just stamp your card.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey now, if you're just going to give it out like that, 
one card won't be enough.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Hehe, that might be true.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for your patronage.①

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That again... You don't have to say that every time, 
you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT:
[FI] I know but... I'm just so grateful for each little thing 
you do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Oh, okay.

[FI] Taking the card back, I notice there's only one 
space left.

[FI] Also, tonight is the last night of our trip. I'll have to 
give it all I got and seize this last opportunity!

[FI] I pledge to myself, I'll fill up the point card and 
make the night count!
